title: 林渊锦镜 Linyuan Jinjing
subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 1873 survey as reported: 林渊锦镜
evidence.locator: zh.wikipedia 圆明园; 阙维民 2010 citing 刘敦桢 1933
evidence.summary: The survivors of 1860 listed in the survey of 1873 include 林渊锦镜. S06 and a modern list put it in 长春园. 阙维民 writes 林渊锦镜（藻园）. Which is right, we can't say; CC21 has no position yet. The primary source is on the wish list.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
